derivation.edgeAlignment: edges[i] here describes graph.json edges[i]; from/to/type/versionRange/side are repeated so the alignment can be checked.
derivation.graphShape: graph.json carries exactly the ATM10 dependency-graph keys; legacy declaration detail lives here.
derivation.loader: Legacy Forge 1.12 jars declare no per-artifact modLoader string, so graph.json node loader is the empty string (ATM10 vocabulary: javafml, lowcodefml, empty). The pack pins forge-14.23.5.2860.
derivation.nestedWithoutIdentity: Four nested jars declare no mod identity. As in ATM10, a nested jar becomes a nested-mod node only when it declares a mod id, so these four are not graph nodes; they are listed under artifacts with dependencyStatus no-declared-dependencies.
derivation.producedBy: WP0 one-off legacy declaration extraction (untracked; detail in graph-evidence.json)
reads: mcmod.info identity, dependencies, requiredMods, dependants and useDependencyInformation fields
class constant pools and class-level RuntimeVisibleAnnotations/RuntimeInvisibleAnnotations for net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod
@Mod modid, name, version, dependencies, acceptedMinecraftVersions and side/metadata flags
nested jar archive entries and the same declaration sources recursively
reference and override jar bytes, hashed
derivation.restrictedContentReadReason: Class bytes opened solely for constant pool and class annotation metadata; method bodies skipped by attribute length.
derivation.scope: Declared legacy metadata only; not runtime-observed completeness or proof of successful loading.
semantics: Each declaration is retained separately, including duplicate mcmod.info and annotation claims.
mcmod.info supplements annotations; useMetadata/useDependencyInformation flags are preserved, not evaluated as loader execution.
after/before are optional ordering declarations; required-after/required-before additionally require presence.
mcmod.info dependencies are optional after-ordering; requiredMods require presence; dependants are optional before-ordering.
acceptedMinecraftVersions yields a required Minecraft platform constraint only when explicitly present.
Resolution records identity presence only; version constraints remain literal and are not evaluated.
Minecraft/Forge/FML/Java platform spelling is case-normalized only in platformId; to and rawDeclaration preserve publisher spelling.
Explicit -client/-server dependency rule suffixes populate side; BOTH is otherwise the graph-model default, and annotation side flags remain in source declarations.
Clusters partition declared nodes using undirected required internal/nested dependency connectivity only.
Seven mcmod.info files use literal control characters invalid in strict JSON; extraction permits only that JSON extension and records strict-JSON errors explicitly.
Missing/invalid declaration sources and no-declared-dependencies are explicit per jar; no inference is made from method code.
derivation.sourceLocations: Sources name the input artifact filename (plus nestedEntry for jar-in-jar inputs) and the entry or class attribute inside it; no local filesystem paths.
derivation.wildcardExclusion: after:* and before:* order against every mod and depend on no identity. ATM10 has no resolution value for them, so they are listed under excludedDeclarations rather than as graph edges.

artifactSet.binding: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 mod\tartifact\tsha256\n rows for reference and override jars
